format.label: Video format

about.H265: The same look in a smaller file.
about.AV1: The smallest file, but the slowest to make.
about.VP9: Good for putting on the web.
about.ProRes: For editing in video apps. Files are large.

format.showFileSize: , press to show the file size
format.proResHardware: On a Mac, ProRes is made quickly with Apple's hardware (VideoToolbox).

precision.label: Game precision
precision.hint: Higher makes the planets' tail particles look smoother.
precision.invalid: Pick {{fps}} or more, so the game keeps up with the video.

ending.label: Show the result screen
ending.hint: The video keeps going this long after a clear or a miss.

saveTo.label: Save to
saveTo.choosingHelp: A folder window opened in ADOFAI. Pick a folder there.

progress.label: Video progress
progress.keepOpen: Keep ADOFAI open until the video is done.
progress.focusGame: Click the ADOFAI window once to keep going.
